blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Friday appealed for the immediate release of Mark Mabasa, son of slain broadcaster Percival “Percy Lapid” Mabasa, who has been detained by US immigration authorities in California since Sept. 21.
